title Dojo - the martial-arts hall: taiko on the beat, a stick click and a shout of toms, a plucked shamisen-like tune on the "in" scale (D, E flat, G, A, B flat), disciplined and square, a gong between the rounds (D, 90 bpm)
tempo 90
vol 235
meter 4/4
inst pluck v=255,150,100,70
inst kick drum=d4 v=255,220,170,120 d=0,-30,-50,-70
inst tom drum=g4 v=255,190,130 d=0,-35,-60
inst rim drum=g7 v=210,90
inst gong dec=3 sus=0.1 slow
l8
# --- 1-4: the drums alone (two bars, twice)
[ !kick4 r4 !kick8 !kick8 !tom4 |
  !kick4 r8 !rim8 !kick4 !tom8 !tom8 | ]2
# --- 5-8: the tune, square and sparse
@pluck o4 d8 d8 r8 e-8 d8 r8 a4 |
@pluck o4 g8 a8 b-4 a8 g8 e-4 |
@pluck o5 d8 d8 r8 e-8 d8 r8 b-4 |
@pluck o5 a8 g8 e-8 d8 o4 b-4 a4 |
# --- 9-10: the answer from the drums (the toms roll)
!kick4 !rim4 !kick4 !rim4 |
[ !tom16 ]8 !kick4 !kick4 |
# --- 11-14: the tune again, an octave up, ending on the low D
@pluck o5 d8 d8 r8 e-8 d8 r8 a4 |
@pluck o5 g8 a8 b-4 a8 g8 e-4 |
@pluck o5 d8 e-8 g8 a8 b-4 a4 |
@pluck o4 g8 e-8 d8 e-8 d4 r4 |
# --- 15-16: the gong
@gong o3 d2 r2 |
!kick4 !rim4 !kick4 !tom4 |
